context_for_next_testing_agent: Focused browser automation passed on https://proration-preview.preview.emergentagent.com. The old URL redirected to the canonical slug; the canonical page rendered directly; /the-three-streams and /switching-providers rendered; the articles index showed 32 cards including the new canonical article and representative legacy static cards. rca_of_the_issue: The old slug previously existed in the legacy STATIC_ARTICLES array, so it rendered stale 5-paragraph content. The fix redirects the old slug before article lookup and removes the stale static entry, so users now land on the canonical structured 2026 article.
